wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/fix_zip_gate.py: """`ZipArchive` was registered by a gate that could never open for it.

`inject_builtin_spl_classes` inserts `ZipArchive`, but only when `program_may_reference_spl` says
the program can reach one of these classes — and that scan reads `SPL_CLASS_NAMES` and
`PHAR_CLASS_NAMES`, neither of which names it. So a program using `ZipArchive` got "Undefined
class: ZipArchive" from a compiler that has the class. Five tests, one missing name.

The name is added, and so is a GATE that reads both sides: every class the registration inserts
must be reachable by the scan. That turns the next missing name int
